title: A Slime Called Quest
description:
A Slime Called Quest is a solo made, story-rich 16-bit style RPG, where there are no random encounters or grinding. Customize your party's build, embark on quests, and engage in thoughtfully crafted battles. Chapter 1 focuses on the journey of leaving the island. Explore the vibrant environment on the island, meet a diverse cast of Slimes, and engage in a story that will leave you wanting more.

Key Features

• 1 - 4 hours of play time

• Engage in a Conditional Turn-Based battle, where turns can be manipulated

• No random encounters or grinding; only battle with bosses and relevant NPC's

• Battle items replenish themselves after each encounter

• Weapons are not just upgrades; they offer different playstyles and archetypes

• Complex magic system; cast spells of different elements for various effects

• Loosely inspired 16-bit SNES style graphics

• Music inspired and made with SNES samples

Currently, only chapter 1 is finished. The game will be periodically updated with future chapters.
